data.title: Tether Brings Its $184 Billion Stablecoin Back to Bitcoin: Will BTC Regain Its Role as a Payments Network?
data.description: Tether is bringing its $184 billion stablecoin back to Bitcoin for the first time in over a decade, but the technology powering this comeback raises serious questions about whether Bitcoin holders and miners stand to gain anything at all.
